name: Transient Progressive Photon Beams Convergence Analysis
aliases: Asymptotic Analysis of Transient Progressive Photon Beams
definition: Analysis of the asymptotic convergence rate of the variance and bias of the radiance estimator in Transient Progressive Photon Beams, leading to the optimal parameters for minimizing Asymptotic Mean Squared Error (AMSE).
summary: Transient Progressive Photon Beams Convergence Analysis provides the mathematical proof for why specific parameter schedules minimize asymptotic mean squared error, distinguishing itself from the algorithmic description of Transient Progressive Photon Beams.
